Job Description: 

 About the Team: 
 Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.

 The Data Architecture & Platform Engineering team runs the data infrastructure behind Dow Jones products, analytics, and AI across B2B, B2C, and internal use cases. We own the Snowflake footprint which serves as the foundation of all DJ structured data, the surrounding platforms and patterns, and the governance framework. We build for scale, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.   

 


 About the Role: 
 In this role, you will have an important role in supporting our newly branded Dow Jones Energy products and work closely with our US-based Energy business and technical stakeholders. You will work on a modern data platform built on Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python. You'll own small-to-medium features end-to-end, from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support. You also will use AI coding assistants in your everyday work, and pitch in when the team experiments with LLM-assisted approaches to data engineering: query generation, data profiling, documentation, and pipeline debugging. You'll partner with analytics, product, and other engineering teams to ship data solutions people actually use. You will report to the Director - Data Architecture & Platform Engineering. 
 



 You Will: 
 Build and maintain ELT pipelines in dbt and Snowflake, orchestrated with Airflow 
 Write tested SQL and Python for ingestion, transformation, validation, and delivery 
 Design data models that integrate multiple sources and hold up under downstream use 
 Contribute to CI/CD, testing frameworks, observability, and data-quality checks 
 Monitor pipeline health - investigate issues, propose fixes, and escalate when stuck 
 Take part in code review, technical design, on-call rotation, and production support 
 Translate requirements from analysts, product managers, and stakeholders into working data solutions 
 


 You Have: 
 1-2 years’ relevant experience in data engineering, software engineering, or database development 
 Excitement about AI landscape and are curious how it's changing the shape of data engineering 
 Strong SQL, ideally within a cloud warehouse (Snowflake preferred; BigQuery or Redshift acceptable) 
 Working knowledge and experience with using Python for data processing, automation, or scripting 
 Exposure to modern data tooling: Airflow, dbt, or comparable orchestration and transformation frameworks 
 Familiarity with Git and a mainstream CI/CD workflow 
 Degree in Computer Science or related discipline -OR- equivalent work experience 
 


 Nice to have: 
 Tableau or another mainstream BI tool 
 PowerShell or similar scripting  
 Data governance, lineage, privacy, or access-control experience 
 Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure); Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool; APIs 
 Postgres or another traditional RDBMS
